method: OpenAI built-in image_gen edit with transparent background
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: the transparent isometric map background of an existing HTML curriculum game.
Edit target: the attached map image. This is a precise room-interior update, not a redesign of the building.

The problem: four rooms all currently look like the same generic office desk. Make each of B, C, D, E recognizable from its large props, working activity, and visible deliverables even with ALL course labels hidden. Keep the warm hand-inked architectural illustration style, line weight, material colors, and soft daylight of the original.

CRITICAL LOCKED INVARIANTS: exact same canvas, transparent outer background, same isometric camera, same building footprint, same room walls/doors/openings, same central empty walkable corridor and front entrance, same front reception room and receptionist, same front-left three-person team room. Keep the LEFT-MIDDLE content/photo studio (camera, ring light, filming desk) completely unchanged. Keep all door thresholds and walking floor locations unchanged. Only replace furniture/props/actions INSIDE these four named existing rooms. Do not add furniture to the central hall. No visitor character in the corridor. No title text, letters, signage, UI badges or words anywhere in the image. No logos.

B = BACK-LEFT/TOP room above the filming studio, currently a man with a blue browser on his desk. Transform into a WEBSITE DESIGN / WEBPAGE BUILDING STUDIO. One large wall-mounted website blueprint and sitemap is the dominant prop: actual recognizable webpage sections, hero image box, columns, contact form fields, navigation blocks, a connected page tree, without tiny text. A tall phone-size preview sits beside a desktop website preview, clearly the same page adapted to mobile. Paper wireframes and layout swatches on an architect-like tilted desk. The worker is standing or leaning and moving a printed page section onto the board. Blue/purple accents. A visitor should immediately think "building a website".

C = BACK-RIGHT/TOP room, currently a woman with two blue monitors. Transform into CUSTOMER INTAKE AND RESPONSE / INQUIRY AUTOMATION room. Replace the twin-monitor office with a short reception/service counter. Distinct big physical inbox envelopes, a headset/telephone, orderly customer contact cards, and a small bell. On the wall a simple large left-to-right sequence of an incoming envelope tray, three inquiry/contact-card lanes, and an outgoing notification bell, connected by clear drawn arrows. One woman sorting an incoming inquiry card into the right tray. Coral accents. Make it read as an active inquiry desk and automatic handoff, not a podcast studio or generic chat screen.

D = RIGHT-MIDDLE room, currently a man surrounded by three blue chart monitors. Transform into a SALES ANALYSIS AND REPORTING ROOM. A large warm orange/yellow data board occupies the back wall: visibly different product rows, colored bar charts, a rising/falling weekly line, and a small spreadsheet heatmap. A worker stands by the board comparing a paper sales report to a chart. On the desk: open spreadsheet laptop, paper ledger, calculator, receipt roll and a neat small stack of reports. Replace the bank of three identical monitors. No piles of cash, coins or investment/trading symbols. It should read as "read shop sales, compare data, prepare reports."

E = FRONT-RIGHT/BOTTOM room, currently another man with two blue monitors. Transform into a SMALL CUSTOM SOFTWARE TOOL WORKSHOP. Use a tidy green-accented maker's workbench, not heavy machinery. Dominant artifact: an oversized tangible calculator-like APP PROTOTYPE standing on the desk, with distinct input fields, plus/minus or numeric keypad blocks, and one output area, all as clean blank graphic controls (no text needed). Beside it, an obvious file-organizing demonstration: several loose colorful document sheets lead via a simple arrow into three neatly sorted folder trays. On the back wall pegboard, individual small app-widget cards are connected into a simple input -> calculation -> result diagram. The worker is arranging these small interface modules by hand. Include a pencil, ruler, test checklist, laptop with a compact little tool UI. Green accents. It should read as "build a personal calculator and file helper", visibly different from B's full website architecture and D's business charts.

Art direction: business-specific, a few large readable purposeful props rather than dozens of tiny widgets; hand-drawn editorial office illustration; natural plants and wood retained where they do not block the functional props. All new content stays within each original room footprint. Preserve the flat connected floor and all room entrances exactly. Preserve real transparent alpha outside the building.
